title: Recursive Room / Wormhole Door Grammar
purpose: Define how the Potato House behaves when every Dwelling and nested Room may become locally central while preserving one global Axis and canonical ownership.
global_rules: The House is a typed graph rendered as architecture, not one fixed Euclidean building.
Every canonical Dwelling and mature nested Room may become a local center.
Global spatial center remains Door / Axis.
Local recentering changes perspective and nearby Doors, not knowledge ownership.
A cross-Dwelling adjacency is rendered as a Wormhole Door: direct conceptual passage across otherwise distant architectural regions.
Wormhole adjacency must come from registered topology/interfaces, never from visual convenience alone.
Every spatial route must preserve a readable HTML/text route.

door_types.definition: Passage between Rooms within the same parent Dwelling.
Registered adjacency between nested Rooms owned by different Dwellings.
door_types.example: Subculture, Cult & Group Formation -> Law & Justice

door_types.definition: Passage back to global Door/Axis or between Heaven, World and Below projections.
Exit from spatial projection into a readable canonical public page.
Guarded passage into testing, verification, repair or promotion.

recursion.rule: Each level may become a local center, but only Levels 1-2 own bounded-context navigation. Level 3 objects remain inhabitants/contents unless explicitly promoted by governance.

reconfiguration.on_enter_dwelling: Show nested Rooms prominently; keep parent exit and global Elevator available.
reconfiguration.on_enter_nested_room: Show registered adjacent nested Rooms around the viewer. Same-parent neighbors appear as local doors; cross-parent neighbors appear as wormholes.
reconfiguration.on_enter_case: Keep the nested Room and its Doors architecturally visible; move the selected inhabitant onto the center table. Expose type, active Room lens, alternate Room lenses, readable route, evidence boundary and return-to-Room action.
reconfiguration.on_escape: Nested Room -> Dwelling -> Door/Axis -> World default.

orientation_invariants: Up/down always means projection toward Heaven/Below relative to the global Axis, never moral rank.
Parent Dwelling must remain visible in breadcrumb even when a nested Room has cross-Dwelling neighbors.
Cross-Dwelling traversal changes the active parent Dwelling if that neighbor becomes locally central.
Back/escape must reconstruct the path taken rather than infer a Euclidean hallway.

object_focus.rule: Level 3 contents may become informational centers but never architectural or ownership centers.
object_focus.lens_switch: The same object may move between registered Room projections without duplicating the object.
